reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, same false positive as the webhook one in #1954, good to see the StatefulSet analyzer covered too.

Both lookups in `pkg/analyzer/statefulset.go` now report "does not exist" only on `IsNotFound`, and the Forbidden reactor test covers the Service and the StorageClass path. Build, lint and codecov are green.

One thing to fix: `validate` fails on the title, because `deps` is the only allowed scope. Rename it to something like `fix: only report missing Service/StorageClass on NotFound in the StatefulSet analyzer` and this is ready.
